effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] You may digivolve 1 of your other Digimon into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name in your hand for its digivolution cost. When digivolving with this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
